description: The acid spit of the Floatstinger and the Twinfeeler. Distances in metres, times in seconds, stored as Q12 the way the original's float constants converted. A spit flies for "life" seconds along a line and leaves "segments" glow sprites over "length" metres; where it lands it bursts into drop.count droplets. look: textures (page = texture page word, palette = [x, y] in video memory), draw-order offsets, the screen box beyond which sprites are skipped; the halo is drawn at a quarter of the core's brightness. maps: per map name the spit settings on normal difficulty and the keys hard changes. Every key is checked: an unknown key is an error. A mod replaces the whole file with its own copy at the same path.

look._slot_offsets: depth words taken off so the glow draws over what it lights
